div.div: صِمَغٌ (AZ, O, K) and ↓ صِمَغَةٌ , (K,) or the latter is the n. un. of the former, and in like manner صِمَخٌ and صِمَخَةٌ, the latter being the n. un., (AZ, O,) or ↓ صِمْغٌ and صِمْخٌ, of which ↓ صِمْغَةٌ and صِمْخَةٌ are the ns. un., (Az, on the authority of A 'Obeyd, TA,) A dry substance which is found upon the teats (AZ, Az, O, K) of a she-camel (AZ, O, K) or of a ewe or she-goat, (Az, TA,) when she is milked on the occasion of her bringing forth: (AZ, Az, O:) when that is rent asunder (إِذَا فُطِرَ ذٰلِكَ [in the CK قُطِرَ]), the milk is clear and sweet. (AZ, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
